svg.aria-label: The 64 bits of the double nearest to 0.1: sign 0, exponent 01111111011, and a 52-bit fraction of repeating 1001 groups that ends in 1010 because it was rounded up

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 64 bits: 1 sign bit, 11 exponent bits, 52 fraction bits. These are the real bits Python prints for 0.1.

text.tspan: 1019 in decimal. Minus the bias 1023: 1019 − 1023 = −4, so × 2

svg.text: “1001” repeats forever (0.1 has no exact binary form),

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so it is cut off after 52 bits. The last bits …1010 show it was rounded up.
